author: KEXP
description: Australian quartet The Belair Lip Bombs offer magnetic power-pop and vibrant indie rock in our latest in-studio session. With host Troy Nelson, the band share a performance of "Don't Let Them Tell You (It's Fair)" and more.
title: The Belair Lip Bombs performs "Don't Let Them Tell You (It's Fair)" & more Live on KEXP
